[SWS_DM_00949] Generation and usage of internal DiagnosticDataElements
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04127, RS_Diag_04190
⌈
If an
internal DiagnosticDataElement
with context "DEM" gets used when the
error memory is read out via diagnostic communication, the DM shall use the current
value of that
internal data element
at the time when the error memory is read
out.
